assessment: The two processes run on the planet at the minimal configuration with their access measured and declared; the three existing recipes are untouched; the volume budget closes to 1e-9 of the eroded volume and every land cell drains monotonically. The minimal world's relief is too low to judge the pass: its land-mean denudation is 0.83 m/Myr, nearly all eroded material redeposits on land, and only four one- or two-cell depressions exist; A6 at 256 columns is the first look. The legacy stages after the erosion (rivers_and_basins, basin_policy) lower about 700 coastal cells below the sea level in both recipes, which Phase B removes from eroded-world.
verdict: integration runs; checks pass; look not yet judged
lessons: A dispatch case that calls a helper which writes fields (getlandandseatotals) is an undeclared write of that process even when the audit happens to see no change; keep the stage body to the process and let the measured declaration cover it.
Inputs gathered once for an evolver that recomputes its own mask must be gathered for every cell (runoff over the sea), or cells that change class during the run get none.
